title: Certify current R437 chart invertibility and uniform owner separation
body:
PR[2989](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2989)'s independent owner-separation audit retained chart invertibility as a premise. This package certifies all 1,235 actual current R437/OQ4 chart labels over Z[1/2]:236 have determinant +1 and 999 determinant −1. Their inverses therefore exist at every odd modulus. It also recertifies the changed 659-role source: all 5,619 canonical same-family role pairs have an entry difference ±1 or±1/2, giving179,808 separated pairs across 288 calls. This establishes the actual caller's owner-key guard uniformly for every invertible common low and every high lift, without enumerating GL64.

The source is the unpooled PR[3647](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3647)/a24f9ff OQ4 catalogue, ordered digest `cbfea55f5cd0b74a2a0d4292ad0139d2b5bb73127951127698030bc90c73c532`, through the byte-exact PR[3967](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3967) adapter. The mathematical pairing is finite-field matrix-group actions with disjoint writable packet interfaces. The proof fixes the native/common multiplication direction, includes high carries, and applies the existing route/separation arguments to a conditional gather/local/scatter commuting square on arbitrary dirty payloads. Old rank34 IDLE histories cannot be relabeled as current rank26/42 histories by invertible conjugation.

The complete transport operation count is `253728*N*(G+S) + 379584*N*R`, with completed gather/scatter/route tariffs including setup, transfers and disposal. Residual children, ordinary wrappers, original-width stock, numerical reserves and visited-cell bounds remain additional obligations.

Validation: registered normal and optimized CPython 3.12.3 replays pass, authenticating 134 canonical inputs and five retained source files, then regenerating the exact certificate. Controls reject duplicate charts, odd-prime determinants, odd denominators and differences vanishing mod3; a separate semantic example exposes stale-scatter lost writes. Actual native rank26 chart 98 produces24 nonzero carry entries from a zero-high identity header in each of three diagnostics. These are algebraic checks and a source-loop refinement under primitive contracts; no full GL64 physical packet or supplier admission is claimed.

Scope: only `research/r437-native-transport/` changes. Canonical main 20ecf289 and priority 6 were refreshed unchanged at entry and submission. PR[2989](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2989) already proves the general owner-separation and conditional-ordering principles for the old source; this contribution closes its chart-invertibility premise for the current source and refreshes the changed owner inventory. The sibling whole-program and resource lanes are separate and are not dependencies of this package. Selected frontier unchanged.

Credit Chris R/Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Nick Petalas/PR[2989](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2989) and his source/owner transport lineage; zxv/PR[3690](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3690); Jose Manuel and David Arias/PR[2753](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2753)/[2809](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2809)/[2899](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2899)/[3562](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3562); ai-nanachi and Ali Romman/PR[3647](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3647); PR[3936](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3936)/[3950](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3950)/[3967](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3967); and all retained geometry, hosting and tape/parking contributors. Detailed predecessor notices remain intact. Apache-2.0. Coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3967#issuecomment-6262146714.

Publication commit `24f680cdbb015dca72b977a99dbec69f24576661`: exact149-file byte and declared source-history preflight passes, as does whitespace validation. Retained source line endings are explicitly preserved by package Git attributes. Scientific verifier and receipt bytes are unchanged after the successful registered replay.
